name: example-backend
_test_report_note: JUnit the test/coverage gate writes; nextest needs `[profile.ci.junit] path = "junit.xml"` in backend/.config/nextest.toml. vitest: --reporter=junit --outputFile=...; jest: jest-junit; pytest: --junitxml=...; go: gotestsum --junitfile ...
_worktree_setup_note: Runs in each fresh worktree of a parallel wave before its doer starts (only with economy.worktree_doers): install dependencies, warm what the targeted tests need. npm: `npm ci`; pnpm: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; Python: `uv sync`. Leave it out when a fresh checkout can test as is.
_idle_timeout_note: No output for this long = the command is stalled (a deadlock, a lock held elsewhere, a dead connection): its whole process tree is killed and the gate fails with that reason. Absent or 0 = off. Keep it above any silence the suite has on its own (go test prints nothing per package for up to its -timeout, 10 min by default; Python buffers output when piped unless -u).
